pages.title: Upgrade Slots
pages.text: Upgrade slots grow with tier (T3 = 3, T7 = 8). Drop modules in through the GUI, or Shift+Right Click them onto the machine.$(br2)$(item)Speed$(), $(item)RF Efficiency$() and $(item)Buffer$() stack $(l)multiplicatively$(). $(item)Efficiency$() is $(l)linear$(), and $(l)4$() of them reach break-even. Max 4 of a type.
